title: 물량 배분 변경의 자문용 이력 증거 비교

criteria.scope: request and history compare only on exact input year and full WW-SS week with positive customer/product keys; SS accepts 01 through 99, and validated combined scope contains WW-01 plus WW-02
criteria.identity: sourceIdentity is a string and is not converted to an object or alternate schema
criteria.evidence: requires mappingConfirmed, explicit exact unit, valid timezone-bearing timestamps, and changeAt >= sourceAt; optional asOf limits evidence only
criteria.date: a request with a shipment date requires an exact date match; without a date all candidate dates are considered and differing dates are ambiguous
criteria.delta: ADD is positive qty and CANCEL is negative qty; finite positive qty is required and epsilon=1e-6 compares without rounding or mutation
criteria.ambiguity: duplicate request id, multiple candidates, or a history event claimed by more than one request makes every affected result AMBIGUOUS; one sourceIdentity may legitimately contain multiple distinct request items
criteria.coverage: zero candidates returns NO_MATCHING_HISTORY only with historyComplete=true; otherwise it returns NEEDS_REVIEW and cannot establish deletion/orphan evidence
criteria.currentRows: current rows are non-authoritative context and never create a matching-history, applied, or complete result without an eligible history event
criteria.advisory: every result has advisoryOnly=true and none of the exports or statuses assert apply, completion, saveability, or an ERP processing result

crossYearFixture.description: A 2025 same-week history event is excluded from a 2026 request.

dnspyEvidence.note: This module is pure comparison code. It has no database, API, or ERP write dependency and returns advisory evidence only.
